Algernon Blackwood, John Silence Stories.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/algernon-blackwood/john-silence-stories

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Algernon Blackwood, author, died 1951 (Wikidata Q507991, death 1951-12-10).

First publication of the text used: 1908, in the United Kingdom: John Silence was first published in 1908 (Wikipedia, John Silence: infobox country 'United Kingdom'). SE colophon: 'John Silence Stories were published between 1908 and 1914 by Algernon Blackwood.'

Why this is public domain:
- United Kingdom: the country of origin is the United Kingdom, where the term is life plus 70 years. The last person to die was Algernon Blackwood, in 1951, so the work entered the UK public domain on 1 January 2022.
- United States: the text was first published in 1908, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
